questions.text: The api has no answers or sources yet (only a starter 'settings' table). How should POST /reports check that the reported answer or source exists (the 404 rule)?
options: Add minimal answers and sources tables in the api now (tenant-scoped, id only), to be filled by the conversation feature later
Wait: build this after the conversation feature that stores answers and sources
Store the target id without an existence check for now (404 rule deferred)
questions.reason: Acceptance criteria 9 and 10 need the targets to exist in the user's tenant; no feature stores them yet, and each option changes the schema and the plan.

questions.text: There is no personal-data deletion flow in the api yet. How should 'delete all of a user's reports when their personal data is deleted' (criterion 14) be delivered?
options: Provide a tenant-scoped function that deletes a user's reports, to be called by the deletion flow when it is built (tested on its own)
Build an internal endpoint now that deletes a user's reports
Defer criterion 14 to the data-deletion feature
questions.reason: The deletion flow belongs to the Data and consent controls feature, which does not exist yet; how criterion 14 is met changes what this work item delivers.

questions.text: Should this work item also build the report button and dialog in the web app (as shown in mock.md), or only the API?
questions.reason: The requirement scope is 'one authenticated API endpoint', but mock.md shows the web dialog; adding web makes the web app (APP-017) a second application of this work item.
